extension_rule: Use domain.action names. Add a new name only when input/output or side-effect semantics differ; provider names are forbidden.

capabilities.name: tracker.read
capabilities.description: Read canonical work items and status
capabilities.input: query or work-item identity
capabilities.output: work items with canonical identifiers and status

capabilities.name: tracker.query
capabilities.description: Query canonical work items by stable planning identity, revision, relationship, or state
capabilities.input: bounded query with project scope and semantic selectors
capabilities.output: candidate work items with canonical identifiers, revisions, relationships, and status

capabilities.name: tracker.create
capabilities.description: Create a work item in the canonical tracker
capabilities.input: validated work-item contract

capabilities.name: tracker.update
capabilities.description: Update an existing canonical work item
capabilities.input: work-item identity and bounded patch

capabilities.name: tracker.change_state
capabilities.description: Apply an authorized canonical work-state transition
capabilities.input: work-item identity, expected current state, mapped transition, and owner authority
capabilities.output: confirmed canonical state and transition evidence

capabilities.name: tracker.link_dependencies
capabilities.description: Create or update dependency relationships
capabilities.input: work-item identities and relationship

capabilities.name: design.inspect
capabilities.description: Inspect editable design context
capabilities.input: design resource identity and requested scope
capabilities.output: design nodes, variables, components, and provenance

capabilities.name: design.create_editable
capabilities.description: Create an editable design artifact
capabilities.input: approved visual contract and target context
capabilities.output: editable resource identity and node map

capabilities.name: design.update
capabilities.description: Update an editable design artifact
capabilities.input: approved bounded change and resource identity

capabilities.name: design.export
capabilities.description: Export a design artifact
capabilities.input: resource identity and export format

capabilities.name: diagram.create_editable
capabilities.description: Create an editable diagram
capabilities.input: diagram semantic contract

capabilities.name: diagram.open
capabilities.description: Inspect an editable diagram
capabilities.input: diagram resource identity

capabilities.name: diagram.update
capabilities.description: Update an editable diagram
capabilities.input: diagram identity and bounded semantic change

capabilities.name: diagram.export_svg
capabilities.description: Export a diagram as SVG
capabilities.input: diagram identity

capabilities.name: repo.read
capabilities.description: Read project repository content
capabilities.input: path or query

capabilities.name: repo.write
capabilities.description: Write a bounded project repository change
capabilities.input: approved paths and content

capabilities.name: source_control.diff
capabilities.description: Inspect source-control changes
capabilities.input: revision or working-tree scope

capabilities.name: source_control.commit
capabilities.description: Create a source-control commit
capabilities.input: reviewed staged paths and message

capabilities.name: source_control.open_pr
capabilities.description: Open a pull request or equivalent review request
capabilities.input: branch, target, title, and body

capabilities.name: pipeline.inspect
capabilities.description: Inspect provider-side pipeline run, job, step, and execution-evidence state without mutating it
capabilities.input: pipeline, run, source/build identity, and requested evidence scope
capabilities.output: observed run/job/step state, attempts, evidence references, and provenance

capabilities.name: pipeline.inspect_policy
capabilities.description: Inspect provider-side pipeline and environment execution policy without changing it
capabilities.input: pipeline/environment scope and requested trigger, runner, concurrency, protection, or required-check policy
capabilities.output: observed policy state, environment bindings, concurrency/protection constraints, and provenance

capabilities.name: pipeline.execute
capabilities.description: Start or retry a bounded non-deployment pipeline execution whose declared maximum effect is no stronger than EXTERNAL_WRITE; use stronger semantic capabilities for deployment, destructive work, or external communication
capabilities.input: pipeline identity, fixed source/build inputs, execution intent, declared effect boundary, and authority context
capabilities.output: pipeline run identity, attempt identity, observed execution state, evidence, and provenance

capabilities.name: pipeline.update_policy
capabilities.description: Update bounded non-secret provider-side pipeline or environment execution policy without editing repository workflow source or granting release/deployment authority
capabilities.input: pipeline/environment identity, expected current policy, approved non-secret bounded patch, and authority context
capabilities.output: observed updated policy state, changed fields, and provenance

capabilities.name: artifact.inspect
capabilities.description: Inspect an immutable build or delivery artifact in an artifact store or registry
capabilities.input: artifact identity, digest or lineage selector, store/channel scope, and requested provenance
capabilities.output: artifact identity, digest, availability, provenance, publication/promotion lineage, and source relationship

capabilities.name: artifact.publish
capabilities.description: Publish or promote an exact immutable artifact within a configured artifact store or registry without deploying runtime state
capabilities.input: source artifact identity, exact digest and provenance, target store/channel, and bounded publication intent
capabilities.output: published artifact identity, verified digest, provenance, publication/promotion lineage, and observed target state

capabilities.name: browser.inspect
capabilities.description: Inspect a rendered or live browser state
capabilities.input: URL or local artifact plus state intent

capabilities.name: browser.capture
capabilities.description: Capture browser evidence
capabilities.input: state, viewport, actions, and redaction policy

capabilities.name: deploy.plan
capabilities.description: Produce a deployment plan without executing it
capabilities.input: candidate and environment
capabilities.output: plan, checks, rollback, and authority needs

capabilities.name: deploy.execute
capabilities.description: Execute an authorized deployment
capabilities.input: approved candidate, target, and rollout plan

capabilities.name: deploy.rollback
capabilities.description: Execute an authorized rollback
capabilities.input: deployment identity and rollback target

capabilities.name: observability.read_logs
capabilities.description: Read bounded logs
capabilities.input: service, environment, time range, and filters

capabilities.name: observability.read_metrics
capabilities.description: Read bounded metrics
capabilities.input: metric identity, population, environment, and time range
capabilities.output: metric evidence with definitions and caveats

capabilities.name: service.inspect
capabilities.description: Inspect bounded current service/resource control-plane and operation state without mutating runtime state
capabilities.input: service identity, environment, target resource scope, and requested current-state or operation-state evidence
capabilities.output: observed service/resource/control-plane state, operation state when applicable, evidence references, and provenance

capabilities.name: service.execute
capabilities.description: Execute a bounded non-deployment, non-destructive normal service control-plane action whose declared maximum effect is no stronger than EXTERNAL_WRITE; security/identity, external communication, deployment, destructive, source-write, or other stronger semantics must use a stronger semantic capability or remain BLOCKED/UNSUPPORTED
capabilities.input: service identity, environment, exact target resources, current state, bounded operation intent/parameters, authority context, repeat-safety basis, and required postconditions
capabilities.output: operation identity, provider acknowledgement separated from observed result, observed target state, verified postcondition evidence, residual/partial state, and provenance
